content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment platforms often overlook creators in regions like Kenya, leaving them with limited options. By utilizing blockchain-based payments, you eliminate reliance on these conventional platforms. NOWPayments enables you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that your customers can pay with ease while you retain full control over your sales infrastructure. This solution is not just a workaround; it's a robust architecture that empowers you to bypass payment restrictions and create a sustainable business model.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your ebook store, you need to gather the necessary components. Start with a domain name to establish your online presence. Next, set up a free hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. You'll also require a backend service, which can be handled using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Don’t forget to register for NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions. This foundational setup ensures that you have everything at your disposal to create a powerful digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to configure your payment and delivery systems. With NOWPayments, you can easily integrate cryptocurrency payment processing into your store, allowing transactions to settle in under 60 seconds with minimal fees. For delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host your ebooks, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation. This streamlined pipeline not only enhances customer experience but also guarantees that you maintain control over your products.
Unlock global sales potential with cryptocurrency payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set up, you are ready to go live. Announce your ebook launch through social media and other marketing channels. Ensure that your payment gateway with NOWPayments is fully operational and test it with a small transaction. Confirm that your delivery system functions as expected. Once everything is verified, you can confidently start processing orders. The ability to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies opens your store to a global audience, expanding your reach significantly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial launch, scaling your operations is the next logical step. Consider adding more products to your store to attract a broader audience. Utilize insights from your sales data to optimize your offerings. Engage with your customers for feedback and adjust your marketing strategies accordingly. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional resources and templates to help you expand your digital commerce stack effectively. With your infrastructure firmly in place, growth becomes an attainable goal.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Instant delivery ensures customer satisfaction and retention.

It offers all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register a domain name for your ebook store. Set up free hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Choose a backend solution like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Sign up for NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. Host your ebooks on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your payment and delivery systems before going live. Announce your launch across your marketing channels.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments without Stripe?
You can accept payments using NOWPayments, which allows you to process over 300 cryptocurrencies without the need for Stripe. This method is efficient and ensures you can reach customers globally.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than traditional payment platforms. This ensures better profit margins for your ebook sales.
How do I set up my ebook delivery system?
You can set up your ebook delivery using platforms like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. These services allow you to store your ebooks and provide instant access to customers upon payment confirmation.
Can I sell ebooks internationally from Kenya?
Yes, you can sell ebooks internationally from Kenya by using cryptocurrency payment methods. This bypasses traditional financial barriers and expands your customer base globally.

To scale your ebook business, consider adding more products to your store and utilizing marketing strategies to reach a larger audience. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides resources to support your growth.
